purpose: Provide a fully explicit deterministic route-law control in which NEXT, state bounds and a polynomial progress rank are known, so TRUMP can validate the PCNER_GPEI contract against a real algorithm without conflating the result with SAT.

functions.Ch(x,y,z): (x AND y) XOR ((NOT x) AND z)
functions.Maj(x,y,z): (x AND y) XOR (x AND z) XOR (y AND z)

message_schedule.W[0..15]: sixteen big-endian uint32 input words from the current padded 512-bit block

round_transition.T1: h + Sigma1(e) + Ch(e,f,g) + K[t] + W[t] mod 2^32

block_finalize: H[i] := H[i] + working[i] mod 2^32 for i=0..7

padding.rule: append one 1 bit, then zero bits until length is congruent to 448 mod 512, then append original bit length as uint64 big-endian
padding.block_count: B(N)=ceil((8N+1+64)/512) with the usual zero-padding adjustment, equivalently len(padded_message)/64 bytes

POLY_FIND.law: There is exactly one scheduled next round transition at each nonterminal round state.

POLY_HOLD.law: Working state uses eight uint32 words plus a 64-word uint32 schedule for one block; streaming execution does not require retaining the full route trace.
POLY_HOLD.input_relative_bound: O(1) working words plus input storage/streaming buffer; total encoded input is O(N)

POLY_ADVANCE.strict_descent: mu_next = mu - 1 on every round transition

EXACTNESS_CERTIFICATION.method: independent comparison against Python hashlib.sha256 plus published fixed test-vector digests
EXACTNESS_CERTIFICATION.scope: finite executable control plus direct inspection of the fixed transition law; not an independent formal proof assistant proof

DEBT_RESOURCE_ACCOUNTING.rule: No unbounded trace materialization, advice, search, deferred semantic oracle, or representation-switch debt is permitted in the control run.
